name: process-review
title: Weekly process review
for_each: select id,code from processes order by code

sections.title: Outstanding work
sections.sql: select item,reason,owner from attention_queue where process_id=$1 order by item

sections.title: Observed paths
sections.sql: select path,cases,closed_cases,mean_closed_hours from variant_summary where process_id=$1 order by cases desc

name: case-history
title: Case history and checkpoint record
for_each: select id,code from cases order by code

sections.title: Events
sections.sql: select activity,started_at,ended_at,resource,role from events where case_id=$1 order by started_at,event_key

sections.title: Checkpoint findings
sections.sql: select checkpoint,finding,source_ref from checkpoint_findings where case_id=$1

name: improvement-record
title: Process improvement action
for_each: select id,code from actions order by code
